ItemID: 1; Title: SAMSUNG T7 Portable SSD 500GB - Up to 1050MB/s - USB 3.2 External Solid State Drive, Blue (MU-PC500H/AM); ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for portable file transfers alongside my existing desktop external drive.
ItemID: 2; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent Fire TV Stick 4K Max bundle already covers this need.
ItemID: 3; Title: Soundcore Anker Life Q20 Hybrid Active Noise Cancelling Headphones, Wireless Over Ear Bluetooth Headphones, 40H Playtime, Hi-Res Audio, Deep Bass, Memory Foam Ear Cups, for Travel, Home Office; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am browsing practical computer and Alexa accessories, with no current need for headphones.
ItemID: 4; Title: Echo Show 8 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- HD smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Sandstone; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The larger display interests me, but I would pass this time after recently getting a Show 5 and its stand.
ItemID: 5; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to extend my basic door alarms with cameras that work with my Alexa devices.
ItemID: 6; Title: Seagate Exos X18 16TB Enterprise HDD - CMR 3.5 Inch Hyperscale SATA 6Gb/s, 7200 RPM, 512e and 4Kn FastFormat, Low Latency with Enhanced Caching (ST16000NM000J); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have used external storage, but have no established need for a large enterprise internal drive.
ItemID: 7; Title: HDMI Switch Aluminum 4K 60Hz, JSAUX Bi-Directional HDMI Splitter 2 in 1 Out, 1 Input 2 Output HDMI Switcher 2 Ports, Manual Monitor Splitter 2 x 1/1 x 2 UHD 1080P 3D Compatible for Box PS4 -Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to make switching between my Blu-ray player and Fire TV more convenient.
ItemID: 8; Title: Samsung 970 EVO Plus SSD 2TB NVMe M.2 Internal Solid State Hard Drive, V-NAND Technology, Storage and Memory Expansion for Gaming, Graphics w/ Heat Control, Max Speed, MZ-V7S2T0B/AM; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not planning an internal computer upgrade and would need to verify hardware compatibility first.
ItemID: 9; Title: 1 Foot Short USB C Cord Fast Charge 5 Pack Durable USB A to USB Type C 3A Fast Charging Cable for Charging Station Compatible with Samsung Galaxy Note 20 A20 A51 S10 S20 Plus Ultra LG Stylo K51; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no current need for five short USB-C charging cables.
ItemID: 10; Title: JOUNIVO USB Microphone for Computer, PC/Laptop Mic, Mute Button with LED Indicator, 360 Degree Gooseneck Design, Desktop Microphone for Streaming, Recording, Dictation, Podcasting, YouTube, JV610; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My webcam already includes a microphone, and I have no current reason to add a separate desktop mic.
